name: Stanford AIMI Summer Research Internship
org: Stanford Center for AI in Medicine and Imaging
what_you_do: Mentored, hands-on summer research with real health data, using artificial intelligence to study problems in medicine.
who_can_apply: High school students. Age, grade and location rules are not on the page. Ask staff or attend the Nov 10 info session.
pay_detail: Pay or cost not stated on the page
deadline_text: Summer 2027: application opens Nov 10, 2026 and closes Feb 1, 2027. Free online info session Tue Nov 10, 2026, 5 to 6pm Pacific.
how_to_apply: Application opens Nov 10, 2026. The page says the info session covers the application process. Questions: aimi-hs-programs@stanford.edu.
notes: The page does not state eligibility, length, pay or cost, or whether it is in person. Confirm all of that before applying.
